newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Bus falls from bridge in Azerbaijan, kills 46.
newsitem.headline: Bus falls from bridge in Azerbaijan, kills 46.

text.p: At least 46 people, including 12 children, were killed when a passenger bus plunged from a bridge in Azerbaijan in the early hours on Monday, Russia's Itar-Tass news agency said.
Tass quoted the Azeri Interior Ministry as saying another nine people had been rushed to hospital with injuries after the accident in the the western Tauz region.
The Azeri Turan news agency said earlier that the vehicle's brakes failed when it was crossing the river Tovus-Chai, 430 km (270 km) west of the capital Baku.

The bus, carrying mostly Georgian nationals of Azeri origin to the Georgian city of Bolnisi from Baku, smashed through a safety barrier on a bridge across the river and fell from a height of 15 metres (50 feet).
Azeri officials could not be reached for confirmation of details. Turan initially estimated the death toll at 26.
